selection:

    - ScriptBlockText|re: '\w+\`(\w+|-|.)\`[\w+|\s]'
    #- ScriptBlockText|re: '\((\'(\w|-|\.)+\'\+)+\'(\w|-|\.)+\'\)' TODO: fixme
